comparison.purpose: Context-window management: a chat loop that compacts its own history. When the message array exceeds a threshold, a dedicated `compacting` state summarizes the stale messages (folding in the prior summary) and keeps only the last N turns, then feeds the summary back as context. Compaction is an explicit, inspectable machine state rather than hidden middleware.
